title: Esau Sells His Birthright
reflectionText: Esau came in from the field famished, and he swore away his birthright for a bowl of red stew. He ate, and rose, and went on his way — and despised his birthright. The lasting thing was spent on the pressing thing. What have you been tempted to trade for something that will not last the day?
